boards.title: Your First Weekend at SUNY Maritime College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe campus sequence that moves from getting oriented to seeing the waterfront and settling in with campus resources.

cards.title: Start with the Welcome Center
cards.subtitle: First stop: locate the campus entry point
cards.notes: Use the campus map to orient yourself at the Welcome Center and Admissions building, then identify the main paths before making plans elsewhere.
cards.short_summary: A practical first landmark for learning the campus layout.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s campus map lists the Welcome Center and Admissions as a campus destination.
cards.access_notes: Confirm visitor access and any check-in requirements with the college before arrival.

cards.title: Walk to Fort Schuyler
cards.subtitle: Next: get acquainted with the historic campus centerpiece
cards.notes: Approach Fort Schuyler as a named campus destination and pause to understand how its waterfront setting anchors the college’s historic core.
cards.short_summary: The historic fort at the center of the campus experience.
cards.evidence_claim: The Maritime Industry Museum states that it is housed in historic Fort Schuyler on SUNY Maritime College’s campus.
cards.source_title: About the Maritime Museum | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: Fort areas may include administrative or academic spaces; follow posted access rules.

cards.title: See the Maritime Industry Museum
cards.subtitle: Then: make time for the museum inside the fort
cards.notes: Enter through Fort Schuyler’s sally port during posted visiting hours to view maritime artifacts, ship models, photographs, and navigational objects.
cards.short_summary: A free, public-facing introduction to maritime history on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime says the Maritime Industry Museum is in Fort Schuyler, open Monday through Saturday from 9 AM to 4 PM, with free admission and parking.
cards.source_title: About the Maritime Museum | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: Official page lists visiting hours as Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–4:00 PM; verify before going.

cards.title: Find Stephen B. Luce Library
cards.subtitle: Later: set up your study landmark
cards.notes: Locate the library and browse its catalog or ask about research support, especially if your interests touch shipping, oceanography, engineering, or maritime law.
cards.short_summary: The college library and a maritime-focused research resource.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime identifies Stephen B. Luce Library as its academic library and describes collections in marine transportation, naval science, oceanography, engineering, trade, and maritime law.
cards.source_title: Stephen B. Luce Library | SUNY Maritime College
cards.access_notes: Check the library website for current hours and visitor policies.

cards.title: Locate the Maritime Academic Center
cards.subtitle: Midday: identify a major academic destination
cards.notes: Use the campus map to find the Maritime Academic Center, then note its route from the fort and residence halls for your first week of classes.
cards.short_summary: A named academic building on the SUNY Maritime campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s campus map lists the Maritime Academic Center as destination 22.
cards.access_notes: Building access may vary outside scheduled classes or events.

cards.title: Get your bearings at the Mess Deck
cards.subtitle: Meal break: identify the main dining location
cards.notes: Find Vander Clute Hall and the Mess Deck on the campus map so you know the dining route before weekday routines begin.
cards.short_summary: The map-listed dining destination in Vander Clute Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s campus map identifies Vander Clute Hall and the Mess Deck as destination 7.
cards.access_notes: Dining access and meal-plan use are subject to current campus dining policies.

cards.title: Locate Riesenberg Gymnasium
cards.subtitle: Afternoon: note the recreation building
cards.notes: Walk by Riesenberg Gymnasium and Swimming Pool to add the recreation facility to your mental map; ask campus staff about current student use.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed gymnasium and pool facility.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s campus map lists Riesenberg Gymnasium and Swimming Pool as destination 5.
cards.access_notes: Pool and gym use can require current student eligibility and facility-specific rules.

cards.title: Pass Reinhart Athletic Field
cards.subtitle: Outdoor stop: find the field before a campus event
cards.notes: Find Reinhart Athletic Field on a daylight walk and keep it in mind for college athletics or outdoor events that are open to the campus community.
cards.short_summary: A named athletic field on the campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s campus map lists Reinhart Athletic Field as destination 23.
cards.access_notes: Field availability depends on athletics, practices, and scheduled events.

cards.title: End with a daylight look at Olivet Pier
cards.subtitle: Waterfront stop: view the named pier from permitted areas
cards.notes: Use the map to identify Olivet Pier and enjoy the waterfront only from open, designated areas; respect barriers, staff instructions, and vessel operations.
cards.short_summary: A named pier on the campus waterfront.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s campus map lists Olivet Pier as destination 20.
cards.access_notes: Waterfront and pier access can be restricted for safety or operations; stay in publicly permitted areas.

cards.title: Close at The Point
cards.subtitle: Final stop: mark a waterfront campus landmark
cards.notes: Find The Point using the campus map as a final orientation landmark, then head back by established campus paths before conditions become less visible.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed landmark that completes a campus orientation loop.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Maritime’s campus map lists The Point as destination 17.
cards.access_notes: Use established, permitted paths and observe waterfront safety signage.

warnings: Most campus buildings and waterfront areas may have access restrictions; confirm current campus policies before visiting.
